title: RAG Techniques collects runnable patterns for better retrieval
friendlyTitle: Learn and compare many ways to improve RAG search
summary: RAG Techniques is a roughly 29,400-star collection of notebooks and runnable scripts covering advanced retrieval-augmented generation methods, including contextual retrieval, graph-based approaches, reranking and evaluation. It was updated this week and uses a custom non-commercial license.
friendlySummary: This popular repository provides notebooks and scripts for several methods that help AI find better information before answering.
whyItMatters: Teams can use the examples to compare retrieval patterns before committing to a framework or production architecture. The notebooks are educational starting points rather than drop-in production systems, and commercial users should check the repository’s license before reuse.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use the examples to test ideas and understand trade-offs. Production use needs more engineering, and businesses should check the non-commercial licence.
